# Sanctum

Sanctum is a minimalist theme built around refined typography and callout-based sidenotes for unobtrusive margin commentary. Image-asides can be sized and aligned, checkbox styles are expanded, and dozens of further options are exposed as style settings.

![Sanctum screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdanielmourao/obsidian-sanctum/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sanctum"
    author: "jdanielmourao"
    repo:   "jdanielmourao/obsidian-sanctum"
    slug:   "sanctum"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sanctum"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jdanielmourao/obsidian-sanctum"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdanielmourao/obsidian-sanctum/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Create a minimalist, serene workspace with refined typography and callout-based sidenotes for unobtrusive margin commentary. Customize versatile image-asides with sizing and alignment, expand checkbox styles, and tweak dozens of style settings for focused writing."
}
```
